title: The Harper & Novak family archive
description: A fictional demonstration archive: an Irish family from County Mayo and a Slovak family from Kapušany who met in Pittsburgh, told through records, photographs and family memories.

quick_focus.label: Michael Harper, the emigrant from Mayo
Josef Novak, from Kapušany to Windber

branches.title: Harpers
branches.about: Tenant farmers from Louisburgh, County Mayo, and three generations of steelworkers in Lawrenceville, Pittsburgh.

branches.title: Novaks
branches.about: Slovaks from Kapušany near Prešov who came by way of Hamburg, Chicago and the Windber coal fields to Pittsburgh's South Side.

questions.text: Does anyone know the names of Kate Doyle's parents, or where in New York she was born?
Did anyone in the family ever mention an aunt Honora (Nora) Harper who lived in Pittsburgh in the 1880s?
Was there a Michal (Michael) Novák in the family who came to America with Josef in 1892?
Does anyone have letters from Thomas Harper, ‘the brother who went to Liverpool’?
Do any photographs of Rose's birth parents, the Sabos of Windber, survive?
Did Daniel Harper's letters home from France in 1918 survive? Who had them last?
